Please review the asks below and drop updates into the workbook I linked. We need final numbers and risk tags by 11:30am PT so we can prep slides.

- Karthik: confirmation on ob-side timeline (runtime migration window) and any infra prerequisites that would materially change the TTM.
- Grace: current close probability per stage and suggested commit (Best / Likely / Commit).

Pre-call agenda (15–20 min):
1) Quick health check on outstanding blockers (2–3m)
2) Present sanitized numbers and proposed commit (8–10m)
3) Procurement asks & next steps (5m)

Links: workbook in the drive + HubSpot deal (both in the doc list below).
